sed -n '1,320p' src/cli.ts
sed -n '1,240p' README.md

work_dir="'$(mktemp -d)

printf '"'%s\\n' '{\"tasks\":[]}' > \""'$work_dir/empty.json"
printf '"'%s\\n' '{\"tasks\":[{\"id\":\"z\",\"duration\":0},{\"id\":\"a\",\"duration\":0},{\"id\":\"m\",\"duration\":2,\"dependsOn\":[\"a\"]}]}' > \""'$work_dir/zero.json"

  echo "CASE:$name"

done
for name in cycle duplicate bad-json; do
  echo "ERROR_CASE:$name"
  if bun run src/cli.ts plan "$work_dir/$name.json" > "$work_dir/out" 2> "$work_dir/err"; then
    echo "unexpected success"
    exit 1
  fi
  test ! -s "$work_dir/out"
  sed -n '"'1,4p' \""'$work_dir/err"
done
for args in '"'nope' 'plan' 'plan x y' 'plan --bad'; do
  echo \"ARGS_CASE:"'$args"
  if bun run src/cli.ts $args > "$work_dir/out" 2> "$work_dir/err"; then
    echo "unexpected success"
    exit 1
  fi
  test ! -s "$work_dir/out"
  sed -n '"'1,4p' \""'$work_dir/err"
done'
